question: Which of the following responses is characteristic of captopril:

options.opa: It acts as a prodrug that requires prior transformation at the liver level.
options.opb: Causes a competitive blockage of the AT1 receiver.
options.opc: Reduces the concentration of renin in blood.
options.opd: It has shown efficacy in the prevention of diabetic nephropathy.

analysis: Captopril is an angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor that works by inhibiting the conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II, leading to vasodilation and reduced aldosterone secretion.
